Asthma

Ailment respiratory asthma breathing allergy inflammation

Evidence: peer_reviewed

Summary

Chronic inflammatory disease of the airways that causes wheezing, shortness of breath, chest tightness, and coughing.

Symptoms

  • wheezing
  • shortness of breath
  • chest tightness
  • coughing (especially at night/morning)
  • rapid breathing
